svg.desc: Subtracting each object’s first recorded position isolates its displacement. B advances twenty-four millimeters, or 2.4 centimeters, over eight seconds; A advances sixteen millimeters, or 1.6 centimeters. The unit conversion changes the numerical scale, not the comparison.
svg.title: One displacement in millimeters and centimeters
